_doc: The patrol (openspec/changes/patrol-mission design 1): the drill's fields, and a patrol block. The Tern starts docked at the system file's berth on shore power with the impulse drive's breaker open; engineering closes it and drops shore power, helm undocks and the berth's departure path is flown under its limits; the Tern jumps along the route, science sweeps each point, and at the encounter's point the drill's fight runs, the enemy placed at enemy_start_m from the Tern's arrival in its frame and the relay at waypoint_m; then home. A jump needs to be clear of every mass lock (data/ships/tern/jump.json). sweep_s is science's sweep, sweep_range_m how far it sees; drive_ready_min the impulse drive's capability the berth asks for before it opens the clamps; clamps_s how long they take. Read by sc-core::combat::data and sc-core::combat::patrol. clear_mps and loiter_mps are a crew helm's speeds clearing a mass lock and at a point; resend_s how long a crew's patrol command is given to land.
title: Patrol: the Shoals
situation: Undock from Tamsin Station and patrol the Shoals: sweep the Pell beacon, then the relay at the Shoals, where a Hound corvette has been raiding. Drive it off or destroy it, then jump home.

objectives.words: Keep the Tern's hull above zero

orders.helm: Close to turret range. Keep the Hound level with the ship so all four turrets bear, put the bow on it for missiles, and keep moving so it cannot aim.
orders.tactical: Lock the Hound, free the turrets, turn the strongest shield toward it, and fire Gannets when the bow is on it.
orders.engineering: Keep power on the weapons and shields in the fight. When a hit cuts a run, open the schematic and route around it; keep the reactor out of the red.
orders.science: Scan the Hound so Tactical sees its hull, find its weapons' band and tune the shields to it, and keep the shields facing its fire.
orders.captain: Call red alert, keep the crew on task with orders, and take the viewscreen when everyone needs to see the same thing.
orders.laser_port: Keep the port bank charged and fire it when the Hound is on the port side. A shot breaks its shield; where its armour is gone, it breaks the ship.
orders.laser_stbd: Keep the starboard bank charged and fire it when the Hound is on the starboard side. A shot breaks its shield; where its armour is gone, it breaks the ship.
orders.gunner: Take the dorsal turret and shoot down the Hound's fighters before they reach our turrets and banks.
